thread:
maria: Heads-up: updated the PM follow-up with a 'testing & drills' swimlane on the ops board. We need explicit owners and concrete deliverables for: regression suite seeding, canonical prompt sets, load reproduction scenarios, and chaos/kv-eviction experiments. Proposed: ben=regression, eva=prompt sets, dmitri=load, sam=chaos. Confirm or nominate alternates.

ben: I can pick up regression seeding. Steps: pull failing requests, normalise, add unit-level and e2e-level cases, wire CI nightly job against staging, and add flaky tagging. ETA: Wed EOD for first batch.

eva: Promptsets OK. I'll extract ~15 prompts from traces and create labels (regression/flake/edge). Want to add a small QA harness to run prompt regression locally with a mock KV layer. ETA: Thu.

dmitri: I'll model the load reproduction. Key is to replicate the sequence-length skew we saw. Plan: JMeter + k6 scenarios for burst and sustained flows, capture 95/99 token latencies, and store artifacts. Need short-lived infra for controlled runs - @kira can you allocate?

kira: Yes, I can carve out a 6-node preemptible pool for nightly runs (off-peak). Send a small k8s job or helm chart and I'll apply. Also add resource requests so autoscaler won't kill them.

sam: Chaos experiments: propose a two-step approach: (1) tabletop Thurs 30m to align on blast radius and rollback, (2) automated KV eviction run in lab cluster next Tue during maintenance window. I'll draft a playbook PR and a rollback checklist.

maria: Thanks. I'll create the board cards with owners and tentative dates, and schedule the tabletop. Quick sync tomorrow 11:30 to confirm scope. Add blockers in the doc.

ben: Blocker: we need the exact failing payloads and the trace slices. @sre_bot can you attach the export?

sre_bot: Exported artifacts: s3://redwood-incidents/2239/kv-eviction-234/logs_and_traces.tar.gz and ci artifacts at gs://redwood-ci/2239/trace-dumps.zip

nina: Oncall exported the request traces and a small sample of prompts. Gist: https://gist.github.com/ef12ab34 - prompt examples + trace snippets included.

dmitri: With those I can parameterize k6 scenarios. I'll aim to capture token-level latencies and the model's latency tail during burst ramps.

kira: Example k8s job spec I'm expecting (paste the minimal job here when ready):
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: load-burst-run
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: k6
        image: grafana/k6:latest
        args: ["run", "--vus", "200", "burst.js"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```

maria: Also adding a small CI job to fail PRs that cause prompt regressions. After the tabletop we'll convert decisions to tickets on the board: regression cases, prompt labeling, load scenario, chaos runbook.

ben: I'll import the tarball and push the first test set by Wed morning. Will mark PR with test artifacts.

sam: I'll open a draft playbook PR and include a checklist: pre-checks, blast radius limits, monitoring asserts, and rollback steps.

eva: After initial labels, I'll coordinate with QA to establish acceptance criteria for prompt regressions (F1 threshold + human audit for edge cases).

maria: Good. Closing loop: owners ben/dmitri/eva/sam. Milestones on ops board and calendar invites sent. See you at 11:30 tomorrow. :rocket:
